notes: The ASV reorders by taking vengeance after against the house of Judah; both units are aligned to the Hebrew morphemes that license them.
Because that fuses as a single compound subordinator rendering יַעַן (rule 30), as at EZK.25.8; the alternative would mark that added under rule 55, but a conjunction does stand in the clause.
אָשׁוֹם is a Qal cognate infinitive absolute rendered by the distinct intensifier greatly, so it takes that word as its own unit while the finite verb keeps hath ... offended (rule 56).
נִקְּמוּ → revenged himself keeps the reflexive with the Niphal verb, which licenses it (rule 44).
